lines.say: I'm making a ninja fighting game on Roblox.
And you can already play it.
Eight young prodigies, each with their own jutsu.
Real combos, throws, wall runs, and a full screen ultimate.
Yesterday, I made the AI fight itself in a full tournament.
Follow along, and I'll show you every step.
Which ninja should I add next? Tell me in the comments.
Search Ninja Duel on Roblox. It's free.
